QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] What You Must Protect
QuestInfo.0: Your true strength arises from the people you want to defend. Remember why you want to protect Helia and its people.
QuestInfo.1: Your true strength arises from the people you want to defend. Remember why you want to protect Helia and its people.
QuestInfo.2: You could become stronger because you had people to defend, and a home to protect. Your resolve to protect Helia and its people emboldened you once more.
